newsitem.title: USA: Target get U.S. FDA approval to market GDC.
newsitem.headline: Target get U.S. FDA approval to market GDC.

text.p: Target Therapeutics Inc said Friday it received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market its guglielmi detachable coil (GDC) for minimally invasive treatment of vascular lesions.

With this action, the FDA has cleared the way for Target to market the GDC for neuro and peripheral indications such as aneurysms, arteriovenous malformations, arteriovenous fistulas, lesions and tumors, the company said.
The GDC is a soft platinum alloy micro-coil that is delivered into a disease site by a Target Therapeutics tracker micro-catheter.

The coil was previously cleared by the FDA in September 1995 for minimally invasive treatment of patients with intracranial aneurysms that are otherwise considered to be either inoperable or very high risk for surgery, the company said.
